description: Test execution profiles for CI and local development. Maps suites to credential requirements and execution tiers.

smoke.name: Smoke Test Profile
smoke.description: Fast, credential-free health checks and public endpoints. Suitable for cheap CI pipelines.
smoke.notes: No NEAR credentials, no Vault access required. Tests public endpoints only.

integration.name: Integration Test Profile
integration.description: Full integration tests requiring valid JWT and NEAR credentials. Certifies production readiness.
integration.notes: Requires valid NEAR credentials in .near-credentials/ and JWT tokens. Tests authenticated flows.

sdk.name: SDK Infrastructure Profile
sdk.description: Unit-like SDK tests that validate client library behavior without server interaction.
sdk.notes: In-process SDK tests. No network access required. Skips are expected and documented.

stress.name: Stress Test Profile
stress.description: Performance and load tests. Run separately from functional tests.
stress.notes: High-volume requests. May trigger rate limits. Run in isolated environment.

full.name: Full Test Profile
full.description: All tests. Use for comprehensive validation before releases.
full.notes: Comprehensive validation. Requires all credentials and ~15 minutes.

NEAR_CREDENTIALS_MAINNET.description: NEAR mainnet credentials for agent authorization

VAULT_RODIT_JWT.description: RODiT JWT tokens from Vault or environment

pull_request.description: Fast feedback on PRs. Public endpoints only.
